_about: Verified conservation organisation registry. Only homepage URLs are stored: deep 'donate' paths change often and rot, whereas homepages are stable and every one of these organisations carries a visible giving link. Liveness of every URL is re-checked weekly by scripts/verify.py.

organizations.name: Re:wild
organizations.role: Successor to Global Wildlife Conservation; funds field partners protecting the most irreplaceable species and places, and runs the Search for Lost Species.

organizations.name: Fauna & Flora
organizations.role: Founded in 1903 as the Society for the Preservation of the Wild Fauna of the Empire; works mainly through local partner organisations.

organizations.name: Wildlife Conservation Society
organizations.role: Runs long-term field programmes in nearly 60 countries, with particular strength in landscape-scale protected-area management and wildlife health.

organizations.name: WWF
organizations.role: Global conservation organisation working on protected areas, wildlife trade policy and species recovery programmes.

organizations.name: Zoological Society of London
organizations.role: Scientific society running the EDGE of Existence programme, which prioritises species that are both Evolutionarily Distinct and Globally Endangered.

organizations.name: Durrell Wildlife Conservation Trust
organizations.role: Specialises in the rescue of species reduced to very small populations, particularly island endemics; pioneered captive breeding for release.

organizations.name: African Parks
organizations.role: Assumes full management responsibility for national parks under long-term agreements with African governments — currently 20-plus parks.

organizations.name: Wildlife Conservation Network
organizations.role: Sends 100% of donations designated for its partner programmes to the field; hosts the Elephant Crisis Fund, Lion Recovery Fund, Pangolin Crisis Fund and Rhino Recovery Fund.

organizations.name: Mohamed bin Zayed Species Conservation Fund
organizations.role: Small grants for species-level conservation, including many little-known plants, invertebrates and amphibians.

organizations.name: World Land Trust
organizations.role: Buys and protects threatened habitat through in-country partner organisations that hold the land title.

organizations.name: Rainforest Trust
organizations.role: Funds the creation and expansion of protected areas in the tropics, working through local partners.

organizations.name: The Nature Conservancy
organizations.role: Large land and water protection organisation; substantial marine protection and freshwater work alongside terrestrial holdings.

organizations.name: TRAFFIC
organizations.role: Wildlife trade monitoring organisation whose trade research informs CITES decisions and enforcement.

organizations.name: WildAid
organizations.role: Works on the demand side of wildlife trafficking, plus marine protected-area enforcement.

organizations.name: IFAW
organizations.role: Combines rescue and rehabilitation with landscape work and anti-trafficking enforcement support.

organizations.name: Born Free Foundation
organizations.role: Wild animal welfare and conservation, with long-running programmes on big cats, elephants and primates.

organizations.name: Panthera
organizations.role: Conservation organisation devoted to wild cats; runs anti-poaching, corridor and monitoring programmes.

organizations.name: BirdLife International
organizations.role: A partnership of national bird conservation organisations; compiles the bird assessments for the IUCN Red List.

organizations.name: American Bird Conservancy
organizations.role: Habitat protection, invasive predator control and collision reduction across the Americas.

organizations.name: The Peregrine Fund
organizations.role: Birds of prey worldwide: captive breeding, release and the vulture crisis response in Africa and Asia.

organizations.name: Vulture Conservation Foundation
organizations.role: Coordinates the European bearded vulture and cinereous vulture reintroductions and campaigns against veterinary diclofenac.

organizations.name: Amphibian Survival Alliance
organizations.role: Global partnership of organisations working on amphibian conservation, including the response to chytrid fungus and habitat loss.

organizations.name: Amphibian Ark
organizations.role: Establishes rescue populations for amphibians that cannot currently be saved in the wild.

organizations.name: Turtle Survival Alliance
organizations.role: Explicit mission of zero turtle extinctions; runs assurance colonies and confiscation response for trafficked tortoises.

organizations.name: Turtle Conservancy
organizations.role: Protects the most threatened tortoises and freshwater turtles, including by buying their habitat outright.

organizations.name: Sea Turtle Conservancy
organizations.role: Founded in 1959; nesting beach protection and satellite tracking.

organizations.name: Oceana
organizations.role: Campaigns for national-level fishery policy change, on the argument that a few big policy wins outperform many small projects.

organizations.name: Whale and Dolphin Conservation
organizations.role: Dedicated cetacean charity; entanglement, bycatch and captivity work.

organizations.name: Marine Megafauna Foundation
organizations.role: Research and protection for sharks, rays and other large marine species, especially in the Indian Ocean.

organizations.name: The Manta Trust
organizations.role: Global coordination of manta and devil ray research and the fight against the gill-plate trade.

organizations.name: The Shark Trust
organizations.role: Science-led advocacy for shark and ray fishing limits and trade controls.

organizations.name: Sea Shepherd
organizations.role: Direct-action marine patrols; runs net-removal operations in the upper Gulf of California and partners with coastguards on IUU fishing.

organizations.name: Coral Reef Alliance
organizations.role: Works on reef resilience — water quality, fisheries management and adaptation — rather than on transplanting alone.

organizations.name: Xerces Society
organizations.role: Invertebrate conservation organisation working on pollinators, freshwater mussels and other overlooked animals.

organizations.name: Bat Conservation International
organizations.role: Bat roost protection, white-nose syndrome response and island fruit bat recovery.

organizations.name: Botanic Gardens Conservation International
organizations.role: Coordinates the world's botanic gardens on ex-situ plant conservation and maintains the GlobalTree Portal.

organizations.name: SHOAL
organizations.role: Works only on freshwater species, a group that attracts a small share of conservation funding.

organizations.name: Save the Elephants
organizations.role: Long-term elephant research and GPS tracking in Samburu, Kenya; co-founder of the Elephant Crisis Fund.

organizations.name: Elephant Crisis Fund
organizations.role: Joint Save the Elephants / WCN fund; 100% of donations reach field projects stopping poaching and ivory trafficking.

organizations.name: Big Life Foundation
organizations.role: Community ranger units across the Amboseli-Tsavo-Kilimanjaro ecosystem in Kenya and Tanzania.

organizations.name: International Rhino Foundation
organizations.role: Funds rhino protection across all five species, including the Sumatran Rhino Rescue programme.

organizations.name: Save the Rhino International
organizations.role: Grants to rhino field programmes in Africa and Asia, with detailed public reporting on where money lands.

organizations.name: Lion Recovery Fund
organizations.role: Aims to double Africa's lion numbers by funding whatever works, from ranger salaries to livestock compensation.

organizations.name: Cheetah Conservation Fund
organizations.role: Namibia-based; livestock guarding dogs, habitat restoration and interception of the Horn of Africa cub trade.

organizations.name: Painted Dog Conservation
organizations.role: Anti-snaring patrols and rehabilitation for African wild dogs around Hwange, Zimbabwe.

organizations.name: Endangered Wildlife Trust
organizations.role: South African conservation NGO running species programmes from vultures and cranes to wild dogs and riverine rabbits.

organizations.name: African Wildlife Foundation
organizations.role: Pan-African organisation combining land protection with community enterprise and government capacity work.

organizations.name: Dian Fossey Gorilla Fund
organizations.role: Daily protection and monitoring of mountain gorillas in Rwanda and Grauer's gorillas in DR Congo, continuing the longest-running gorilla field study, begun by Dian Fossey in 1967.

organizations.name: Gorilla Doctors
organizations.role: Veterinary team treating wild mountain and Grauer's gorillas for snare wounds and disease in Rwanda, Uganda and DR Congo.

organizations.name: International Gorilla Conservation Programme
organizations.role: Coordinates transboundary gorilla protection across Rwanda, Uganda and DR Congo.

organizations.name: Jane Goodall Institute
organizations.role: Chimpanzee research and community-centred conservation in Tanzania and across the chimp range.

organizations.name: Wild Chimpanzee Foundation
organizations.role: Protects West African chimpanzees in Taï, Sapo and Grebo-Krahn, a subspecies down to a fraction of its former range.

organizations.name: Save Pangolins
organizations.role: Coordinates and funds pangolin conservation across both African and Asian species.

organizations.name: Pangolin Crisis Fund
organizations.role: WCN fund directing 100% of donations to stopping pangolin poaching and trafficking.

organizations.name: Madagascar Fauna and Flora Group
organizations.role: Consortium managing Betampona reserve and lemur breeding-for-release programmes in eastern Madagascar.

organizations.name: Lemur Conservation Network
organizations.role: Directory and coordinating body for the many small organisations working on the world's most threatened primate group.

organizations.name: The Aspinall Foundation
organizations.role: Reintroduces captive-bred gorillas and other primates to protected habitat in Congo and Gabon, and runs lemur projects in Madagascar.

organizations.name: MOm / Hellenic Society for the Study and Protection of the Monk Seal
organizations.role: Rescue, rehabilitation and habitat protection for the Mediterranean monk seal in Greek waters.

organizations.name: Sahara Conservation
organizations.role: Conservation organisation dedicated to Saharan and Sahelian wildlife — addax, dama gazelle, scimitar-horned oryx and North African ostrich.

organizations.name: Hirola Conservation Programme
organizations.role: Community-run conservancies in eastern Kenya for the hirola, the most threatened antelope on Earth.

organizations.name: Grevy's Zebra Trust
organizations.role: Community scouts and grassland restoration across the Grevy's zebra's last northern Kenyan range.

organizations.name: Giraffe Conservation Foundation
organizations.role: Organisation dedicated to giraffe conservation and research across Africa, including population surveys and translocations.

organizations.name: Okapi Conservation Project
organizations.role: Supports rangers and communities in the Okapi Wildlife Reserve, Ituri Forest, DR Congo.

organizations.name: Ethiopian Wolf Conservation Programme
organizations.role: Rabies and canine distemper vaccination and long-term monitoring of the Ethiopian wolf.

organizations.name: Seychelles Islands Foundation
organizations.role: Manages Aldabra Atoll and the Vallée de Mai, two of the Indian Ocean's most intact endemic systems.

organizations.name: Mauritian Wildlife Foundation
organizations.role: Brought the Mauritius kestrel and pink pigeon back from single-digit and double-digit populations; still the island's main field body.

organizations.name: Snow Leopard Trust
organizations.role: Snow leopard research and community conservation, including livestock insurance schemes and long-term collaring studies in several range states.

organizations.name: Snow Leopard Conservancy
organizations.role: Predator-proof corrals and Himalayan homestay programmes that make live snow leopards worth more than dead ones.

organizations.name: Wildlife Trust of India
organizations.role: Elephant corridor purchases, rapid-response veterinary units and anti-trafficking work across India.

organizations.name: Wildlife Protection Society of India
organizations.role: Maintains India's independent wildlife crime database and supports enforcement against tiger and leopard poaching.

organizations.name: Bombay Natural History Society
organizations.role: Indian natural history society founded in 1883; runs vulture conservation breeding centres with state governments.

organizations.name: Nature Conservation Foundation
organizations.role: Research-led conservation from the high Himalaya to the Lakshadweep reefs, with strong community programmes.

organizations.name: Wildlife SOS
organizations.role: Rescue and rehabilitation across India, plus habitat and anti-poaching work for sloth bears, elephants and leopards.

organizations.name: Aaranyak
organizations.role: Assam-based; rhino protection in Kaziranga, and river dolphin and elephant work across the Brahmaputra basin.

organizations.name: Save Vietnam's Wildlife
organizations.role: Runs a pangolin rescue, rehabilitation and release programme, plus carnivore conservation in Vietnamese national parks.

organizations.name: Wildlife Alliance
organizations.role: Direct forest protection and ranger patrols in Cambodia's Cardamom Rainforest.

organizations.name: Orangutan Foundation International
organizations.role: Founded by Biruté Galdikas; rehabilitation and release plus habitat protection in Kalimantan.

organizations.name: Borneo Orangutan Survival Foundation
organizations.role: Indonesian foundation caring for several hundred rescued orangutans and running release forests.

organizations.name: Sumatran Orangutan Society
organizations.role: Restores degraded rainforest on the edge of the Leuser Ecosystem, the only place tigers, rhinos, elephants and orangutans still coexist.

organizations.name: Kadoorie Farm and Botanic Garden
organizations.role: Hong Kong-based; South China rapid biodiversity surveys and rescue of confiscated trafficked animals.

organizations.name: Philippine Eagle Foundation
organizations.role: Conservation organisation for the Philippine eagle: captive breeding, forest guard networks and nest monitoring.

organizations.name: Haribon Foundation
organizations.role: Philippine conservation organisation and BirdLife partner; forest restoration and Important Bird Area protection.

organizations.name: Gharial Conservation Alliance
organizations.role: Nest protection and monitoring of gharials on the Chambal and other north Indian rivers.

organizations.name: Turtle Island Restoration Network
organizations.role: Sea turtle and shark protection through litigation, bycatch reduction and beach programmes.

organizations.name: Wildlife Conservation Society Mongolia
organizations.role: Steppe and Gobi programmes covering Mongolian saiga, argali and the wildlife trade.

organizations.name: International Takhi Group
organizations.role: Manages the reintroduction of Przewalski's horse to Mongolia's Dzungarian Gobi.

organizations.name: Great Bustard Group
organizations.role: Reintroduced the great bustard to Salisbury Plain, England, after an absence of more than 150 years.

organizations.name: Rewilding Europe
organizations.role: Landscape-scale restoration across ten European regions, including bison, vulture and large-herbivore returns.

organizations.name: Iberian Lynx Ex-situ Conservation Programme
organizations.role: The captive breeding and release programme behind the Iberian lynx's recovery from under 100 animals.

organizations.name: SEO/BirdLife
organizations.role: Spain's BirdLife partner; imperial eagle, bustard and steppe bird programmes.

organizations.name: Fundación CBD-Hábitat
organizations.role: Works with private landowners on Iberian lynx, imperial eagle and Mediterranean monk seal habitat.

organizations.name: LPO — Ligue pour la Protection des Oiseaux
organizations.role: France's BirdLife partner; bearded vulture and bustard recovery, and seabird bycatch work.

organizations.name: Frankfurt Zoological Society
organizations.role: Long-term support for wilderness areas in Europe, Africa and South America, including the Serengeti and Carpathian programmes.

organizations.name: Noé
organizations.role: French organisation managing protected areas in the Sahel and running species programmes in Europe.

organizations.name: RSPB
organizations.role: UK wildlife conservation charity; reserve management and species recovery in the UK and its overseas territories.

organizations.name: European Association of Zoos and Aquaria
organizations.role: Coordinates the European Ex-situ Programmes (EEPs) that maintain insurance populations for species extinct or near-extinct in the wild.

organizations.name: Defenders of Wildlife
organizations.role: Legal and policy defence of Endangered Species Act listings, plus coexistence work with ranchers.

organizations.name: Center for Biological Diversity
organizations.role: Uses petitions and litigation to secure ESA listings and critical habitat designations.

organizations.name: NatureServe
organizations.role: Maintains the G1–G5 conservation status ranks and the network of natural heritage programmes behind them.

organizations.name: National Audubon Society
organizations.role: Bird conservation across the Americas flyways, with a large volunteer monitoring base.

organizations.name: Ventana Wildlife Society
organizations.role: Releases and tracks California condors in central California and runs the lead-ammunition replacement programme.

organizations.name: Black-Footed Ferret Conservation
organizations.role: Breeding and reintroduction for a species twice believed extinct, alongside prairie dog and plague management.

organizations.name: Red Wolf Coalition
organizations.role: Advocacy and public education for the only wild red wolf population, in eastern North Carolina.

organizations.name: Anderson Cabot Center, New England Aquarium
organizations.role: Holds the North Atlantic right whale photo-identification catalogue used for the official population count.

organizations.name: The Marine Mammal Center
organizations.role: Rescue and veterinary care, including the Hawaiian monk seal hospital at Kailua-Kona.

organizations.name: Porpoise Conservation Society
organizations.role: Organisation dedicated to porpoise conservation, including vaquita advocacy and research funding.

organizations.name: Pronatura México
organizations.role: Mexican conservation NGO; land protection, wetland restoration and species recovery.

organizations.name: Naturalia
organizations.role: Land acquisition and jaguar, wolf and pronghorn recovery in northern Mexico.

organizations.name: Kauaʻi Forest Bird Recovery Project
organizations.role: Last-ditch rescue of Kauaʻi's honeycreepers as avian malaria moves up the mountain.

organizations.name: Maui Forest Bird Recovery Project
organizations.role: Kiwikiu and ʻākohekohe monitoring, translocation and mosquito suppression on Haleakalā.

organizations.name: Bahamas National Trust
organizations.role: Manages the Bahamian national park system, including the last Bahama oriole and Andros rock iguana habitat.

organizations.name: Island Conservation
organizations.role: Removes invasive vertebrates from islands to prevent the extinction of native species.

organizations.name: Charles Darwin Foundation
organizations.role: The permanent science organisation in Galápagos, providing the research behind park management decisions.

organizations.name: Galápagos Conservancy
organizations.role: Funds giant tortoise restoration, invasive species removal and the Galápagos ranger corps.

organizations.name: Fundación Rewilding Argentina
organizations.role: Reintroduced jaguars, giant otters and macaws to Iberá, and donates restored land to the national park system.

organizations.name: Aves Argentinas
organizations.role: Argentina's BirdLife partner; grassland bird and macaw recovery.

organizations.name: Asociación Armonía
organizations.role: Bolivia's BirdLife partner; blue-throated macaw and Beni savanna reserves.

organizations.name: Proyecto Tití
organizations.role: Cotton-top tamarin protection through forest restoration and community enterprise in northern Colombia.

organizations.name: ProDelphinus
organizations.role: Works with Peruvian small-scale fishers to cut bycatch of turtles, dolphins and seabirds.

organizations.name: Projeto TAMAR
organizations.role: Brazil's national sea turtle programme, protecting more than 1,000 km of nesting coast.

organizations.name: Instituto Arara Azul
organizations.role: Nest boxes and monitoring that brought the hyacinth macaw back in the Pantanal.

organizations.name: IPÊ — Instituto de Pesquisas Ecológicas
organizations.role: Atlantic Forest corridor restoration and black lion tamarin recovery.

organizations.name: Onçafari
organizations.role: Jaguar habituation for ecotourism plus reintroduction of maned wolves and other Cerrado species.

organizations.name: Saving Nature
organizations.role: Buys land specifically to reconnect fragmented forest, targeting corridors between existing reserves.

organizations.name: ECOAN
organizations.role: Andean community reserves and Polylepis forest restoration for high-altitude endemic birds.

organizations.name: Forest & Bird
organizations.role: Independent New Zealand conservation organisation; advocacy plus predator control on its own reserves.

organizations.name: Kākāpō Recovery
organizations.role: The Department of Conservation programme managing every living kākāpō as a named individual.

organizations.name: Predator Free NZ Trust
organizations.role: Supports the community trapping networks behind New Zealand's 2050 predator eradication goal.

organizations.name: Zealandia Te Māra a Tāne
organizations.role: Fenced urban sanctuary in Wellington that has returned takahē, tīeke and kākā to a capital city.

organizations.name: Australian Wildlife Conservancy
organizations.role: Runs a network of sanctuaries across Australia, including large feral-predator-free fenced areas holding reintroduced mammals.

organizations.name: Bush Heritage Australia
organizations.role: Private land conservation and partnerships with Aboriginal ranger groups across Australia.

organizations.name: BirdLife Australia
organizations.role: Threatened bird recovery teams for the orange-bellied parrot, regent honeyeater and swift parrot.

organizations.name: Aussie Ark
organizations.role: Insurance populations of Tasmanian devils and other marsupials, and rewilding into fenced sanctuaries.

organizations.name: Australian Koala Foundation
organizations.role: Habitat mapping and campaigning for a Koala Protection Act.

organizations.name: WWF-Australia
organizations.role: Post-bushfire recovery, koala habitat restoration and Great Barrier Reef water quality work.

organizations.name: Tenkile Conservation Alliance
organizations.role: Village-led hunting moratoria that brought the tenkile tree kangaroo back from around 100 animals.

organizations.name: Tree Kangaroo Conservation Program
organizations.role: Woodland Park Zoo programme supporting Papua New Guinea's YUS Conservation Area.

organizations.name: Antarctic and Southern Ocean Coalition
organizations.role: The only NGO coalition with observer status at Antarctic Treaty meetings and CCAMLR; campaigns for marine protected areas.

organizations.name: Oceanites
organizations.role: Runs the Antarctic Site Inventory, a long-term penguin population monitoring programme on the Antarctic Peninsula.

organizations.name: The Pew Charitable Trusts — Antarctic
organizations.role: Policy campaigns for Southern Ocean marine reserves and krill fishery limits.

organizations.name: BirdLife Albatross Task Force
organizations.role: Places bycatch mitigation instructors aboard fishing fleets; has cut albatross deaths by over 90% in some fisheries.

organizations.name: Wildfowl & Wetlands Trust
organizations.role: Wetland reserves and captive-rearing expertise; ran the rescue rearing programme for the Madagascar pochard and the spoon-billed sandpiper.

organizations.name: International Crane Foundation
organizations.role: Works on all fifteen crane species worldwide, combining captive breeding with wetland protection and flyway diplomacy.

organizations.name: Nature Kenya
organizations.role: The East Africa Natural History Society, founded in 1909, and Kenya's BirdLife partner; site support groups at Important Bird Areas.

organizations.name: Monarch Joint Venture
organizations.role: Partnership coordinating milkweed and nectar habitat restoration along the monarch's North American migration corridor.
